extracted.name: Elderflower spritz
extracted.description: Capture a taste of summer in this thirst-quenching spritz cocktail made with prosecco, gin and elderflower liqueur, and garnished with slices of lime.
instruction_lines: Fill a tumbler with ice, then pour over the elderflower liqueur.
Add the gin and prosecco, then top up with soda water and garnish with lime slices to serve.
